process_metrics.method: Linux /proc/PID/status VmHWM; sampled every 100 ms after startup

build: Rust 1.98.1; dev profile; debug=0; incremental=0; two Tokio runtime threads
limitations: One pass per condition, not a statistical load test.
Known source URLs were explicitly read after measuring default discovery.
Ten fixed English-language queries; result counts do not establish relevance.
No LLM, full Fenix runtime, rendering browser or large populated corpus.
HTTP attempts include reservations and can include cancelled work.
Memory phases run in one process; allocator retention and phase order affect RSS.
Concurrency four uses batches of 4+4+2, concurrency ten uses one batch.
